findings.reason: No reachable same-generation slice-length mismatch: capture allocates and fills measured Cells using the retained projection length; currentMeasurement rejects different generation/stamp/viewport. Snapshot cardinality is deterministic from immutable columns/config and stamped row count/viewport. Geometry/source/model changes cannot install differently shaped same-generation projections through the managed owner contract. Arbitrary private-state corruption is outside that contract.

The preserved original adversarial regression deliberately allows either safe preallocation validation refusal or a safe non-aliasing mounted result. Explicit TestDataGridGeneratedNamespaceReserved already requires refusal of generated cell/header/row prefixes in nested modal descriptors and accepts the unreserved ordinary grid ID. Weakening validation reaches the adversarial alias assertions; overbroad refusal fails the explicit acceptance check. Original reviewer regression bodies are retained unchanged.

Separate stateErr from Do return values in all five State reads in grid_offscreen_test.go; assertions occur after checking both errors. Four affected actual offscreen routing/geometry/wheel tests pass with race count3 and driver offscreen vet passes. Runtime inputs and original reviewer bodies remain unchanged.

Application.Do locks owner state and directly invokes fn inline on the calling goroutine; it does not dispatch to another goroutine. These callbacks therefore run on the test goroutine, where t.Fatal is permitted. Do has deferred owner unlock and owner-close handling for interrupted callbacks, so Goexit cannot leak the lock. A hypothetical future asynchronous Do implementation is not the current API.
